app.name: Desk panel
app.summary: A whole page for a desk: with the monitor off, large keys that start a source; with it on, the sources with their state, the monitor's keys, Auto and the PC's switch.
app.tile_example: PC, Mac, PS5 and Switch, monitor, PC
app.script_hint: Optional. A tap on a source runs this script with the option in the field quelle, instead of choosing the option directly.
app.status_hint: Optional. A device that is on while this source runs; its key then shows a dot. In the order of the select's options.
app.auto_hint: Optional. A switch or input boolean that says whether this source turns the monitor on by itself. The Auto key switches it for the chosen source.
app.picture_hint: Optional. On while the monitor shows a picture; its key switches only the picture.
app.power_hint: Optional. On while the monitor is on. It also chooses the view: off shows the large start keys.
app.device_hint: Optional. A switch for a device such as a PC: off, a tap turns it on; on, the tile asks before it turns it off.
